governance: THE CANONICAL RIGHTS RECORDS. One record per organisation, each carrying the Atlas Image Permission Outreach id it reflects. This file is the INPUT; image-rights-manifest.json is generated from it by .github/scripts/generate_image_rights_manifest.py and must not be hand-edited. Recording a grant or a withdrawal means editing a record here, regenerating, and committing both in the same act.
how_to_add_a_supplier: 1. Record the permission in Atlas (Image Permission Outreach) first; that is the source of record. 2. Add a record here carrying its record id and ref. 3. permission_outcome must be one of the gate's live-grant or known-non-grant values, spelled exactly. 4. permitted_domain is the supplier's own site. 5. If their site serves images from a third-party CDN, add permitted_delivery_hosts with the host AND a path prefix narrow enough to be theirs alone -- a host without a prefix is refused. 6. required_credit if the grant is conditional on one. 7. Regenerate. 8. Run the gate.

The operative imagery permission remains the 2 October 2026 grant recorded in 'evidence' above: permission to feature Tanktribe, use selected imagery from its website, clear credit, link back. Scope, conditions and permitted hosts are unchanged by this reply.
preview_approvals.does_not_resolve: This reply does not answer the open TANKKD provenance question recorded against IMG_8455 and DSC_2111, and must not be read as doing so.

records.evidence: Fabian of OGNYX replied on 2 October 2026 to the Home Wellness outreach, Gmail thread 1a0fd83e5f6c284f, message 1a0fe3d7b43366cf: “Before proceeding, we would be interested in seeing the preview of how OGNYX would be presented within PlotNua. Please feel free to prepare the preview, including any example imagery, product presentation and links you propose to use.” Recorded in Atlas as Image Permission Outreach WELLNESS-FIRST-OGNYX-20261002 (recIjRDMQ55nk6cOn) against Organisations recGxi1agXCBR1FLt, contact info@ognyx.com. SECOND REPLY, 13 October 2026, message 1a13699d55beb7f9: “We have reviewed your offer and can confirm we would be happy to proceed with this.” — answering the 12 October ask (message 1a1303acc64d5590) to “use the selected product images shown there”. FOUNDER DECISION, 14 October 2026: treat that as permission for the four specific images shown in the preview, within that approved context, and no wider. Atlas Permission Outcome is now “Granted with Conditions — Founder Confirmed”, limited to those four images on ognyx-preview.html.
conditions: PREVIEW ONLY, FOUR IMAGES ONLY (founder decision 14 October 2026). This permission covers the four images listed in the note, on ognyx-preview.html, and nothing else. No other OGNYX image may be used, and these four must not appear on any other page, in the public Results journey, or in any runtime Atlas payload. Any wider use needs a new written grant from OGNYX and a new founder decision.
Credit '© OGNYX' wherever the imagery appears.
Link back to https://www.ognyx.com/ wherever the imagery appears.
Images are used unmodified and served from OGNYX's own domain. Nothing is downloaded, re-hosted, cropped or altered.
OGNYX may request change or removal of any image at any time, and PlotNua complies.
No resale, no sublicensing, no unrelated advertising use. OGNYX retain ownership of the imagery.
records.note:
SCOPE: ognyx.com only. OGNYX serve their product images from their own domain, so there is no shared CDN to scope by prefix and no delivery host is declared.

THIS ROW EXISTS TO LET THE PRIVATE PREVIEW PASS THE GATE, AND FOR NOTHING ELSE. The gate scopes a grant by host and has no notion of a page, so on its own this row would authorise OGNYX imagery anywhere in the tree. atlas-tools/prove-preview-only-containment.mjs is what keeps it to ognyx-preview.html, and that proof runs in CI beside the gate on every publish. If the preview is ever deleted, this record should go with it.

FOUR ASSETS, all read first-party from ognyx.com on 2 October 2026 and all visually inspected before use: two photographs of the Stainless Steel Cold Plunge Tub for One, one visualisation of the 1.6m Outdoor Sauna, and one visualisation of the Round Hot Tub with integrated wood-fired stove. The two visualisations are labelled as visualisations on the page, because showing a render as a photograph would misrepresent what a homeowner would receive.

14 OCTOBER 2026 — ONBOARDING, SCOPE UNCHANGED. Fabian replied on 13 October 2026 (Gmail 1a13699d55beb7f9) "happy to proceed" to the 12 October ask that named "the selected product images shown there". The founder confirmed that reading on 14 October 2026, limited to those four images on this one page; Atlas Permission Outcome is now "Granted with Conditions — Founder Confirmed". ognyx-preview.html was rebuilt for onboarding with the SAME four images and the 41-product range as text only. This record and its preview-only containment are unchanged.

Credit © Irish Sauna Company and link back to https://irishsaunacompany.com/.
Do not represent supplied Harvia residential garden saunas as manufactured in Galway.

Image integration remains held pending selection of verifiable first-party image URLs and a narrowly scoped Shopify delivery-host path; the grant is not a claim that any asset is currently published.
